capabilities.description: Construct nodes, edges, communities, and relationship evidence.
Detect disconnected, weakly connected, stale, or context-poor assets.
Capture lessons, handoffs, discoveries, failures, and learning loops.
Validate schemas, examples, policies, tests, and acceptance gates.
Build query-specific context packs for humans and AI.
Apply preflight, postflight, authority, scope, and stop-condition controls.
Score value, freshness, reuse, risk, and discovery priority.
Search bounded external sources for missing components.
Classify, redact, restrict, and route sensitive information.
